subject: Wire transfer confirmation — invoice #94821 ($24,300)
body:
Hello,

Please confirm the wire transfer for invoice #94821 totaling $24,300 is being processed this week. Updated routing info is below — note we recently moved banks:

Bank: Pacific Trust
Routing: 555012345
Account: 678901234

Reply with confirmation of the new banking details on file and expected ACH date.

Best regards,
Melissa Tran
AP Manager, NorthGrip Supply Co.

expected_outcome.notes: Under the STRICT scope_gate rules from MILESTONE_1.md §3.2.1 (rules 2/3 require BOTH internal sender AND internal/leadership recipient), this email's external vendor sender fails rules 2/3 and falls to rule 4 → out_of_scope (unknown). That is what the chain will actually emit.

doc_intent.notes: Per MILESTONE_1.md §3.2.6 fixture #4 ('Vendor ACH/payment request lands in a leadership inbox. ACH safeguard in internal context.'), the doc's INTENT is that this email is processed by Phase 1 — vendor ACH escalates to Owner regardless of which internal inbox it hit. The rules in §3.2.1 do not currently allow this because they gate on internal sender. DECISION NEEDED FROM DOC AUTHOR: should scope_gate be loosened to recipient-driven (any email to leadership@ or internal@ is in scope, regardless of sender) so the ACH safeguard works? Yoni / Eaunic to clarify.
